title: Farmaceut till Vaggeryds kommun
description:
1 plats(er).

Vill du vara med och forma en ny och viktig roll samt bidra till en trygg och säker läkemedelshantering inom den kommunala hälso- och sjukvården? Vi söker en legitimerad apotekare eller legitimerad receptarie som trivs med att vara med att bygga från grunden. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta både självständigt och i nära samverkan med tvärprofessionella team, samtidigt som du driver utveckling av arbetssätt som stärker kvalitet och patientsäkerhet för både patienter och medarbetare.

Om arbetsplatsen

I Vaggeryds kommun arbetar vi målmedvetet för att erbjuda våra invånare hälso- och sjukvårdsinsatser av högsta kvalitet – dygnet runt, året om. Nu stärker vi vårt hälso- och sjukvårdsteam med en farmaceut.

Vaggeryds kommun är den genuina kommunen där idéer blir till verklighet. Läget längs med E4:an mellan Jönköping och Värnamo ger goda pendlingsmöjligheter hit, antingen med bil eller kollektivtrafik. Vi har även goda möjligheter för dig som vill flytta till vår fina kommun. Oavsett om du vill bo i villa, lägenhet, på landet eller kanske bygga nytt, finns många attraktiva alternativ för en hög livskvalitet

Hos oss blir du en del av en utvecklande och trivsam arbetsmiljö tillsammans med kompetenta och engagerade kollegor. Vi erbjuder goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling samt varierande och stimulerande arbetsuppgifter. Vår strävan är att skapa en arbetsplats där du känner arbetsglädje, trygghet och får möjlighet att utvecklas i din yrkesroll.

Titta in i vår jobb-vardag på Instagram: sskvaggerydskommun

Arbetsuppgifter

Som farmaceut i vårt team får du ett ansvarsfullt och varierat uppdrag med fokus på kvalitet och säkerhet genom hela läkemedelshanteringskedjan. Du blir en viktig resurs i arbetet med att säkerställa att rutiner, processer och arbetssätt håller hög standard och uppfyller krav på en säker vård.

Du får en nyckelroll i vårt gemensamma arbete genom att:

- Utbilda omvårdnadspersonal inom läkemedelshantering och läkemedelsanvändning

- Genomföra läkemedelsavstämningar vid inskrivning i kommunal hälso-och sjukvård, oavsett boendeform.

- Bidra till utveckling och kvalitetssäkring av rutiner och arbetssätt inom läkemedelshantering.

- Ge stöd och rådgivning till verksamheterna i läkemedelsrelaterade frågor

- Medverka i läkemedelsgenomgångar.

- Delta i utredning och uppföljning av läkemedelsrelaterade avvikelser.

- Ha en aktiv roll vid implementering och användning av läkemedelsautomater

- Rollen innefattar även operativt arbete

Även om rollen innebär ett stort eget ansvar arbetar du i nära samverkan med undersköterskor, sjuksköterskor, arbetsterapeuter, fysioterapeuter samt medicinskt ansvarig sjuksköterska (MAS) i våra tvärprofessionella team. I detta samarbete kommer din specialistkompetens till sin fulla rätt. Du utvecklar även professionella relationer med externa samarbetspartners såsom vårdcentraler, sjukhus och anhöriga, vilket bidrar till ett meningsfullt och utvecklande arbete.

Du får en unik möjlighet att vara med och forma, utveckla och sätta prägel på denna nya och spännande roll hos oss – redan från start.

Kvalifikationer

- Legitimerad apotekare eller legitimerad receptarie. - Minst 2 års erfarenhet från arbete på apotek, klinisk farmaci eller kommunal hälso- och sjukvård. - Erfarenhet från kommunal verksamhet är meriterande. - Erfarenhet av att leda utbildningar och ta ansvar för utvecklingsarbete samt projekt är meriterande. - God kommunikativ förmåga och kommunicerar väl i tal och skrift på svenska. - B-körkort är ett krav då bil används i tjänsten.

För att trivas i rollen behöver du vara självgående och ha förmåga att planera, prioritera och organisera ditt arbete på ett strukturerat sätt, med målet att uppnå hög kvalitet och god effektivitet. Du samarbetar lyhört och professionellt samt anpassar din kommunikation efter situation och mottagare. Med din noggrannhet, ditt fokus på kvalitet och din flexibilitet kan du enkelt växla mellan olika arbetsuppgifter och möta verksamhetens skiftande behov.

Övrigt

I denna rekryteringsprocess ingår intervjuer och referenstagning. Inför anställning kommer du att behöver uppvisa utdrag från misstankes- och belastningsregister.

Till din intervju behöver du ha med dig pass/nationellt ID och eventuellt bevis på uppehållstillstånd om du har ett medborgarskap utanför EU/EES. Detta för att vi som arbetsgivare behöver säkerställa din identitet samt säkra att du har rätt att arbeta i Sverige.

Till de tjänster där det finns krav på utbildning kommer du som går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen att få lämna in underlag som styrker din utbildning, t.ex. legitimation eller examensbevis. Du kan även bifoga dem direkt i din ansökan.

Om du har du skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta rekryterande chef, istället för att söka via vårt digitala system. Vi hjälper dig vidare på ett säkert sätt.

Till dig som företräder bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag: Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.

title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
description:
Job Description Summary

The Graduate Engineer Trainee – Manufacturing will support manufacturing operations and engineering activities while developing practical, hands-on experience in a production environment. The role will work closely with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams to support manufacturing processes, New Product Introduction (NPI), process improvements, fixtures and tooling, quality, productivity, and EHS initiatives.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Support manufacturing engineering activities for existing products and New Product Introduction (NPI).

  • Work with experienced engineers and production teams to understand manufacturing processes, identify issues, and support practical solutions.

  • Assist with manufacturing process documentation, part routings, work standards, and process changes.

  • Support the development and improvement of fixtures, tooling, and manufacturing aids.

  • Participate in process improvement activities focused on safety, quality, productivity, cycle time, lead time, and cost.

  • Participate in Lean and continuous improvement initiatives within manufacturing operations.

  • Assist in analyzing production and quality issues and support implementation of corrective and improvement actions.

  • Support engineering trials, process validation activities, data collection, and documentation as required.

  • Work with Production, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, EHS, and other cross-functional teams on manufacturing activities.

  • Support manufacturing engineering projects and track assigned actions to completion.

  • Interact with suppliers and vendors, as required, with guidance from experienced team members.

  • Follow EHS requirements and actively participate in initiatives to improve workplace safety.

  • Develop technical knowledge of GE HealthCare products, manufacturing processes, quality requirements, and operational systems through structured learning and hands-on experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or Mechatronics Engineering.

  • Recent graduate with an interest in manufacturing, production engineering, process improvement, and hands-on technical problem-solving.

  • Basic understanding of engineering principles and their application in a manufacturing environment.

  • Good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and willingness to learn from experienced engineers and manufacturing professionals.

Desired Characteristics

  • Academic project, internship, or practical exposure related to manufacturing, production, product development, automation, tooling, or process engineering.

  • Basic understanding of Lean manufacturing or continuous improvement concepts.

  • Interest in working hands-on with manufacturing processes, equipment, fixtures, and tooling.

  • Strong attention to detail with an organized approach to completing assigned activities.

  • Ability to analyze problems, learn quickly, and apply engineering concepts to practical situations.

  • Good interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.

  • Self-motivated with curiosity and a willingness to learn in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Inclusion and Diversity

GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

Disclaimer: GE HealthCare will never ask for payment to process documents, refer you to a third party to process applications or visas, or ask you to pay costs. Never send money to anyone suggesting they can provide employment with GE HealthCare.

title: Enhetschef till Infrastrukturenheten
description:
Vill du leda den tekniska grund som får en hel kommun att fungera, varje dag?

Vi söker en enhetschef som vill ta ansvar för att utveckla och säkra vår IT-infrastruktur, från stabil drift och tydliga servicenivåer till långsiktiga vägval, kvalitet och kontinuerlig förbättring.

Det här är en roll för dig som vill kombinera ledarskap, teknik och verksamhetsnytta. Som enhetschef leder du arbetet med att skapa en stabil, säker och hållbar digital miljö för kommunens verksamheter. Som enhetschef har du ansvar för personal, verksamhet och ekonomi. Du ansvarar för både den dagliga leveransen och den långsiktiga utvecklingen inom områden som nätverk, identitet, plattformar, datacenter/moln, backup, övervakning och klientplattform. Du rapporterar till IT chef och ingår i IT-avdelningens ledningsgrupp.

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

  • Leda och utveckla enheten med fokus på stabilitet, säkerhet och kvalitet.
  • Driva livscykelhantering och långsiktiga vägval inom infrastrukturområdet.
  • Säkerställa tydliga servicenivåer, dokumentation och strukturerade arbetssätt.
  • Arbeta med uppföljning, förbättring, riskhantering och kontinuitetsplanering.
  • Ansvara för budget, resursplanering, kompetensförsörjning och leverantörssamverkan.

Kvalifikationer

Som chef i Piteå kommun är du en förebild för andra och tar ett helhetsperspektiv i ditt agerande och beslut. I ditt ledarskap är du tydlig, kommunikativ och skapar engagemang och delaktighet utifrån ett tillitsbaserat förhållningssätt.

Vi söker dig som är en trygg och tydlig ledare med erfarenhet av IT-drift och IT-infrastruktur i en komplex miljö. Du är van att arbeta med leveransstyrning, förändring och utveckling, och du förstår värdet av struktur, samverkan och långsiktighet. Erfarenhet av ITSM/ITIL, SLA/OLA, hybridmiljöer och leverantörsstyrning är viktig i rollen. Du har mycket god svenska i tal och skrift. Körkort är ett krav för tjänsten.

Det här får du hos oss

  • En roll med tydligt mandat och arbetssätt, där du vet när du ska lösa, när du ska eskalera och hur kvalitet mäts.
  • En arbetsmiljö där service, struktur och förbättringsarbete värderas högt.
  • Möjlighet att påverka användarupplevelsen i en mycket omfattande verksamhet.
  • Kollegor med stark vilja att driva och möjliggöra digitalisering i en verksamhet som är viktig på riktigt.
  • Arbeta målstyrt med uppföljning av leveransen med definierade nyckeltal.

Mer om tjänsten

Tillsvidareanställning på heltid med tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

För anställning på IT-avdelningen kommer viss bakgrundskontroll att genomföras.

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 260913

Dina ansökningshandlingar är allmänna handlingar och hanteras enligt offentlighetsprincipen. Har du beslut om skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig kontakta Rekryteringsteamet för alternativ sökväg på telefon 0911-69 65 10.

Om arbetsplatsen

Kommunledningsförvaltningen arbetar på kommunstyrelsens uppdrag med att leda och samordna kommunens ekonomi, personal och verksamheter. IT- avdelningen är en av sex avdelningar och ansvarar för drift, utveckling, service och support av kommunens IT‑plattformar, system och klientmiljöer – både för förvaltningar och kommunala bolag. Vi har en central roll i Piteå kommuns digitaliseringsarbete och arbetar strategiskt och verksamhetsnära för att skapa hållbara, effektiva och robusta IT‑lösningar.

Du blir en del av ett engagerat och positivt team med stark framåtanda. Våra lokaler finns vid Acusticum.

title: Sr. Test Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Test Engineer based in Switzerland.

This is a senior QA opportunity focused on ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of applications in Agile and Scrum environments.
You’ll take ownership of comprehensive testing activities, from test case creation and execution through defect management and validation.
The role combines functional, integration, and regression testing with close collaboration across engineering and business teams.
You’ll help translate functional and technical requirements into effective testing strategies and actionable quality standards.
The position also offers the opportunity to improve testing processes and identify areas where automation can increase efficiency and coverage.
You’ll work independently while contributing to multiple Scrum teams and supporting complex technology initiatives.
This is a strong fit for a detail-oriented QA professional who enjoys solving problems and continuously improving software quality.

Accountabilities:

  • Perform integration, regression, and functional testing to ensure applications meet business, technical, and system requirements.
  • Create, review, maintain, and execute comprehensive test cases for new and modified systems.
  • Analyze functional and technical requirements and translate them into effective testing scenarios and quality criteria.
  • Identify, document, track, and manage defects through resolution while ensuring appropriate validation and follow-up.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders and Scrum teams within Agile delivery environments.
  • Support multiple teams and complex assignments while maintaining consistent quality and testing standards.
  • Apply established software engineering disciplines, change-control standards, and testing procedures throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Participate in peer code reviews and contribute to maintaining engineering and quality standards.
  • Provide insights and recommendations to improve testing processes, coverage, efficiency, and overall product quality.
  • Identify opportunities for test automation and contribute to approaches that support Test Driven Development where appropriate.
  • Work independently while adapting to evolving technologies, methodologies, and testing approaches.
  • Use analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate issues, reconcile results, and identify root causes.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of experience working in Scrum and Agile environments.
    • Extensive experience across the full software testing lifecycle, including test case development, test execution, defect management, and validation.
    • Strong experience performing functional, integration, and regression testing.
    • Advanced analytical, quantitative, deductive reasoning, reconciliation, and problem-solving capabilities.
    • Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to accuracy and quality.
    • Experience with Automated Change Management and established change-control processes.
    • Strong proficiency with word-processing, spreadsheet, and presentation software.
    • Ability to understand and analyze functional and technical requirements and convert them into comprehensive testing scenarios.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Scrum and cross-functional teams.
    • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and take ownership of complex testing assignments.
    • Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and testing methodologies.
    • 3+ years of experience with test automation tools and approaches supporting Test Driven Development is preferred.

      • Benefits:

      • Inclusive workplace committed to equal employment opportunity and diversity.

description:
This position is in the VA Acquisition Academy (VAAA), Acquisition Intern School (AIS) within the Office of Acquisitions & Logistics (OAL). Serves as a supportive program analyst for AIS, responsible for performing a wide range of complex assignments relative to providing training programs for AIS. The incumbent assists in data management, identifying, monitoring, and advising leadership on significant operational, community, communication, and personnel issues or actions for the organization.

Duties include, but are not limited to: As a member of the team, the incumbent will advise AIS leadership on the organization's significant, operational, community, and personnel issues or actions. Evaluates highest-level administrative guidance, transforms it into specific local guidance, issues guidance, defines program submissions, and solicits the submission of program and resource requirements for the organization. Oversees or participates in various academic reviews, manage small scale projects and surveys; collects, aggregates, and presents data; prepares statistical summaries; and prepares briefings. Assists in analyzing and preparing data analysis and developing platforms for data sharing. Monitors, identifies, and highlights issues. Coordinates resolution of issues to the extent possible and determines what issues must be addressed by senior leadership in the organization. Monitors and participates in special projects. Attends meetings with, or on behalf of, program manager and completes follow-up on actions resulting from meetings. Monitors activities or actions of the organization and keeps leadership properly informed of the highest priority items, ensures appropriate individuals are aware of actions requiring their attention, and follows up to ensure actions are properly completed. The incumbent works with the Program Managers and the Vice-Chancellors to collect, manage, analyze, and report performance and program data in support of the AIS accomplishment of operational performance goals and metrics. The incumbent serves in a variety of roles, ranging from project manager to team member to facilitator, as assigned by the Vice Chancellor. These assignments will demand well-developed leadership skills, the ability to perform in subordinate roles of support, the ability to work independently, creative problem-solving skills, patience with "short-fuse" projects, frequent exchanges with upper management, and the daily demand for responsible decision-making capabilities that reflect the mission of the AIS. The incumbent represents and responds directly to the directions and intentions of the Program Manager and indirectly to the Vice-Chancellors, in all instances maintaining a consistent position as an advocate and exemplary steward of a multi-million dollar training program. As a representative of the VAAA, the incumbent will participate in intra-agency, inter-agency, and federal/corporate committees, task forces, panels, and work groups that focus on a wide array of training issues and initiatives involving data analysis on manpower studies, budget allocations, and reports related to professional acquisition training and career development programs. Responsible for developing and disseminating information about the organization both to the public and internal customers/clients. Responsible for the design, development, implementation, and management and the coordination of information using web-based technology, Internet and Intranet, in addition to the more traditional mediums of communication. Develops and transmits informational materials to a variety of internal and eternal entities to enhance understanding of the Acquisition Intern School. Uses a variety of methods and techniques in achieving communications goals such as position papers, news releases, administrative materials, pamphlets, and other documents. title: Data Center Technician - Germany - Freiburg - On-site
description:
Reboot Monkey is a global leader in IT solutions, specializing in data center management that simplifies your IT operations. We provide hosting space, future-proof upgrades, and 24/7 support through our smart or remote hands, ensuring seamless, secure, and sustainable service. Our fully remote, round-the-clock management frees businesses from supervision hassles, setting new benchmarks in data center solutions. We’re seeking skilled Freelance Data Center Technicians to join our growing team. If you have expertise in data center operations and want flexible work, we’d love to hear from you.


Job Overview:

As a Freelance Data Center Technician, you will play a key role in delivering on-demand support to our global data centers. Your responsibilities will include hardware installation, troubleshooting complex issues, and managing network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability. We’re looking for someone with deep expertise in data center equipment and software who can work independently while collaborating with remote teams. In this role, you’ll be essential to maintaining smooth, secure, and efficient data center operations, contributing to our high standards of service excellence.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, and maintain servers, networking equipment, and other hardware to ensure optimal performance and maximum uptime, facilitating seamless operations within the data center.

  • Monitor data center operations both remotely and on-site, quickly diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and connectivity issues to minimize downtime and maintain service reliability.

  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot networking devices, including Cisco and Juniper routers, switches, and firewalls, to ensure secure and efficient network operations that align with organizational standards.

  • Manage and troubleshoot both Linux and Windows-based systems, performing essential updates, patches, and security enhancements to keep systems secure and up-to-date.

  • Document all installations, repairs, maintenance tasks, and system performance, providing comprehensive reports to the remote management team to ensure transparency and accountability in operations.

  • Implement and maintain security protocols to protect the integrity of the data center infrastructure, ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices for data security.

  • Collaborate with remote IT teams, vendors, and stakeholders to enhance data center operations, actively participating in the planning and execution of projects that drive efficiency and innovation.


What We Offer:

  • Flexibility: Work around your existing freelance or permanent job. You choose the tickets you want to pick up, with no minimum hour commitment.

  • Professional Environment: Join a professional work environment where you can reconnect with the practical side of IT.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive rewards for your compensation and efforts.

  • Growth Opportunities: Work with compelling clients and seize opportunities to grow in your field.

  • Data center or IT infrastructure experience

  • Server hardware and networking knowledge

  • Reliable and professional with strong communication

  • Proximity to local data center facilities

  • Flexible schedule for on-call/emergency work

title: Curriculum Integration Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Benefits Analyst based in the United States.

This is a fully remote opportunity for a benefits professional with the expertise to manage complex health and welfare programs in a large organization.
You will serve as a subject matter expert across benefit plans, compliance, vendor relationships, reporting, and employee education.
The role combines benefits administration, data analysis, HR technology, project coordination, and continuous process improvement.
You will work closely with HR, IT, carriers, consultants, and third-party vendors to ensure accurate and efficient benefit operations.
Your work will directly support employees by making benefit programs easier to understand, access, and use.
You’ll also help maintain regulatory compliance, improve integrations, strengthen data accuracy, and support major initiatives such as Open Enrollment.
This role is ideal for a proactive, analytical professional who can independently solve complex issues while building strong stakeholder relationships.

Accountabilities:

  • Serve as a subject matter expert across health, life, disability, retirement savings, wellness, voluntary benefits, and spending account programs.
  • Manage the benefits compliance calendar and coordinate required activities to ensure deadlines and regulatory obligations are met.
  • Monitor regulatory and legal developments, assess their potential impact, and develop recommendations and actions to maintain compliance.
  • Develop and coordinate benefits and wellness communications, educational materials, presentations, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Explain benefit programs and policies clearly to employees at all organizational levels and resolve complex, non-routine benefits questions.
  • Support benefits-related projects, including planning, implementation, change management, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Partner with third-party vendors and internal IT teams to manage system requirements, integrations, electronic files, and data exchanges.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Workday benefits configuration, vendor integrations, and new benefit program implementations, working with HR technology teams to maintain accurate setup.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and oversee system enhancements or changes to ensure data integrity and accurate plan administration.
  • Audit enrollment records against carrier data, investigate discrepancies, coordinate corrections, and follow issues through to resolution.
  • Review benefit invoices and payroll deductions for accuracy, ensuring premiums and employee deductions align with enrollment and contractual requirements.
  • Lead or support improvements to the benefits onboarding experience, ensuring new employees understand available plans, enrollment processes, and resources.
  • Coordinate Open Enrollment activities, including plan renewals, communications, documentation updates, carrier integration changes, workflow testing, and reporting.
  • Prepare reports and perform data analysis to support business decisions, audits, benefits administration, and ad hoc requests.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, harmonize processes, and prevent recurring issues by investigating root causes and implementing sustainable solutions.
  • Collaborate with consultants, benefit vendors, and administrators to evaluate plan utilization and recommend program improvements.

    • Requirements:

    • At least 4 years of professional experience, including a minimum of 2 years directly related to benefits administration and responsibilities comparable to this role.
    • Prior experience and working knowledge of Workday, particularly benefits-related functionality, payroll deductions, integrations, and basic reporting.
    • Experience with benefits administration systems and services.
    • Experience delivering virtual benefits presentations, benefits fairs, or employee onboarding sessions.
    • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
    • Certified Employee Benefits Specialist (CEBS) designation is preferred.
    • Intermediate Excel skills, including VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, and manipulation of data across different formats.
    • Working knowledge of group insurance administration and processing across both self-insured and fully insured plans.
    • Experience overseeing HRIS configuration, system interfaces, implementations, and change management for HR technology or new benefits programs.
    • Ability to coordinate effectively with IT, technical teams, internal stakeholders, consultants, and external vendors.
    • Strong benefits compliance knowledge and ability to understand and apply complex regulations, policies, procedures, and guidelines.
    • Strong data analysis, reporting, project coordination, and process improvement capabilities.
    • Excellent attention to detail and ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and develop practical solutions.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex benefits information in clear, accessible language.
    • Self-motivated, collaborative, confident, and solutions-oriented, with the ability to take initiative and work with limited direction.

title: AI Transformation & Strategy Consultant
description:
We’re looking for an AI Transformation Consultant to help organizations rethink how work gets done using generative AI, automation, and agent-based workflows.

In this role, you’ll work closely with business and technology leaders to identify high-impact opportunities for AI, rapidly prototype solutions, and help scale AI-enabled ways of working across the enterprise. You’ll operate at the intersection of strategy, operations, and applied AI — helping clients move from experimentation to measurable business impact.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who combines structured problem solving with curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and a builder’s mindset. You should be excited by fast-moving technologies, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and motivated by solving real business problems with AI.

You’ll have the opportunity to work directly with modern AI platforms and tools, including LLMs, copilots, workflow automation platforms, and agentic systems, while partnering with cross-functional teams to shape how organizations adopt AI responsibly and effectively.

What You’ll Do

Identify & Shape AI Opportunities

  • Partner with business stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities for generative AI, automation, and AI-enabled transformation
  • Translate ambiguous business challenges into practical AI use cases, workflows, and solution concepts
  • Help prioritize AI initiatives based on business value, feasibility, scalability, and user impact
  • Define success metrics tied to efficiency, adoption, quality, and measurable business outcomes

Design & Deliver AI-Enabled Solutions

  • Help design, prototype, and implement AI-powered workflows and agent-driven solutions across functions such as operations, finance, sales, customer support, and enterprise services
  • Structure multi-step workflows, including decision logic, orchestration, inputs/outputs, and human-in-the-loop processes
  • Collaborate closely with technical, product, and data teams to move solutions from pilot to scaled deployment
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools and platforms to identify practical enterprise applications

Drive AI Transformation Execution

  • Support end-to-end delivery across multiple AI and transformation initiatives
  • Drive execution across cross-functional teams while balancing speed, quality, and business priorities
  • Help establish scalable operating models, governance approaches, and implementation best practices for enterprise AI adoption
  • Navigate ambiguity and solve complex problems in fast-paced client environments

Measure Impact & Optimize

  • Track adoption, performance, and business impact of AI-enabled solutions
  • Analyze user feedback, workflow outputs, and operational metrics to continuously improve effectiveness and user experience
  • Refine prompts, workflows, and operating processes to improve reliability and business outcomes
  • Support the development of repeatable playbooks and scalable delivery approaches

Enable Adoption & Change

  • Help organizations adopt new AI-enabled ways of working through training, change management, and stakeholder engagement
  • Educate business teams on how to effectively and responsibly leverage AI tools and solutions
  • Develop documentation, playbooks, and best practices to support scalable adoption
  • Partner with legal, risk, and compliance stakeholders to support responsible AI implementation
  • 2–7 years of experience in management consulting
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Experience supporting digital, data, automation, or AI-related initiatives in a consulting or enterprise environment

  • Hands-on experience experimenting with AI tools such as OpenAI, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, or workflow automation platforms is strongly preferred
  • Ability to translate business problems into structured solutions and practical implementation approaches
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with experience working across business and technical teams
  • Product and solution-oriented mindset with a focus on driving measurable business impact
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, evolving environments with a high degree of ownership and ambiguity
  • Demonstrated curiosity for emerging AI capabilities and a willingness to continuously learn and experiment
  • Experience working with enterprise systems, data platforms, CRM tools, or operational workflows is a plus
  • Exposure to Agile delivery methodologies or transformation programs is preferred
  • Experience in consulting, technology, financial services, or fintech industries is a plus

Why Join Us

  • Work on real-world AI transformation initiatives across industries
  • Help organizations operationalize generative AI at scale
  • Collaborate with strategy, product, data, and engineering teams
  • Experiment with emerging AI tools, copilots, and agent-based workflows
  • Shape how enterprises adopt AI responsibly and effectively
  • Join a fast-growing team focused on the future of enterprise AI transformation
  • Build highly valuable experience at the intersection of business strategy and applied AI

This role does not require deep machine learning engineering expertise. However, candidates should be comfortable working closely with technical teams and actively experimenting with modern AI tools and workflows.

Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.

title: Integration Lead (Workday)
description:
Integration Lead

About the company

A national professional services group that has grown quickly through acquisition and is now putting Workday in across HR, payroll and finance. The programme is deliberately lean, run by an experienced internal leadership team with an implementation partner delivering alongside them. Decisions get made in the room, and there is very little between you and the people running the project.

About the role

You own every integration in the Workday programme through to production, plus the technical side of cutover. Around 15 systems, all point to point, no middleware. You will work hand in hand with your counterpart on the implementation side, own the specs, and hold the third party vendors on the far side of each connection to account. Reporting into the programme leadership.

Duties / Key responsibilities
  • Own the integration plan across roughly 15 point to point connections into Workday HCM, payroll and finance
  • Write and manage technical and functional integration specs, and chase the implementation partner on the ones they own
  • Manage third party vendors on the far side of each integration, covering recruitment, screening, banking, expense and data warehouse
  • Own the technical architecture from the client side, including integration diagrams agreed with the delivery partner and the internal enterprise architecture function
  • Lead single sign on, identity management and user provisioning setup with the internal IT team
  • Work with the test lead to define integration scenarios, trigger integrations and validate results
  • Build and own the technical cutover run sheet, sequencing system switch offs, switch ons and verification
  • Hand over cleanly to a BAU owner at the end of the phase
Who you are

You have done this before, on a landscape you could actually get your head around.
You are genuinely hands on. Some days that is architecture diagrams. Other days it is running the test yourself because there is no business owner for that system yet.

You know where the line sits between what the delivery partner owns and what the client owns, and you hold it without escalating every time.

You have been inside an ERP or HR transformation before, so nobody needs to explain to you what a payroll system does or why the finance data matters.

Workday integration experience helps but is not the gate. If you understand field level mapping and can write a clean technical spec, the source system matters less than you might think.

Benefits
  • Direct access to the programme leads with no layers in between
  • Unusually broad scope, covering integration, architecture, testing and cutover in one role
  • End to end ownership of a Workday HCM, payroll and finance go live
  • Small team, so your work is visible and your calls stick
  • A clean, well scoped landscape, so your time goes on delivery rather than untangling legacy
Skills and experience
  • Experience leading integrations on an ERP, HR or finance transformation
  • Proven ability to write technical and functional integration specifications
  • Strong grasp of field level data mapping between source and target systems
  • Experience managing an implementation partner and third party vendors, including pushing back on scope and effort
  • Working knowledge of single sign on, identity management and user provisioning
  • Comfortable planning and running technical cutover, including run sheets and sequencing
  • Willing to get hands on with integration testing and validation
  • Point to point integration experience without reliance on middleware
  • Exposure to enterprise architecture teams and how integration sits in the wider landscape
  • Workday integration experience

title: ServiceNow-utvecklare
description:
Vilka är vi?

Unibase är ett växande IT-företag med passion för att skapa värde för våra kunder genom smarta tekniska lösningar. Vi arbetar med spännande projekt och samarbetar med kunniga kollegor. Om rollen

Vi söker en erfaren ServiceNow-utvecklare till Unibase!

Som ServiceNow-utvecklare kommer du bland annat att:

  • Utveckla, konfigurera och anpassa lösningar i ServiceNow-plattformen
  • Arbeta med moduler som Incident, Problem, Change, CMDB och Service Catalog
  • Säkerställa att lösningarna följer best practice och kundens behov
  • Delta i projekt för implementation, integration och vidareutveckling av plattformen

Du blir en viktig del av vårt och kundens team och bidrar till att leverera effektiva och framtidssäkra ITSM-lösningar.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kan bestå av följande (beroende på uppdrag):

Utveckling och konfiguration:

  • Skapa och anpassa workflows, business rules, UI policies och script
  • Implementera integrationer med externa system via API:er
  • Utveckla rapporter och dashboards för uppföljning och analys

Förvaltning och optimering:

  • Underhålla befintliga lösningar och säkerställa hög tillgänglighet
  • Felsöka och åtgärda problem i plattformen
  • Dokumentera konfigurationer och förändringar

Projekt och innovation:

  • Delta i design och implementation av nya moduler och funktioner
  • Bidra med idéer kring automatisering och effektivisering
  • Arbeta med uppgraderingar och nya versioner av ServiceNow

Meriterande erfarenheter

Det är positivt om du har erfarenhet av:

  • Certifieringar inom ServiceNow (t.ex. Certified System Administrator, Application Developer)
  • ITIL v4 eller liknande ramverk för IT-styrning
  • Scriptning i JavaScript och kunskap om REST API
  • Integrationer mot andra ITSM-verktyg eller affärssystem

Din bakgrund

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Minst 5 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom ServiceNow-utveckling
  • God förståelse för ITSM-processer och ServiceNow-arkitektur
  • Eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT eller motsvarande erfarenhet
  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt

Varför ska du bli en del av vår familj?

Vårt engagemang för mångfald och inkludering

Vi värdesätter mångfald och strävar efter att skapa en inkluderande arbetsmiljö. Alla kvalificerade sökande uppmuntras att ansöka, oavsett kön, ålder, etnicitet, religion, funktionsvariation eller sexuell läggning. Vi tror att olika perspektiv berikar vårt team och vår verksamhet.

title: Cyber Security Lead
description:
Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it's easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is passionate about getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers. It's not about surface-level change. It's about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.

The Cyber Security Lead is responsible for delivering and managing cyber security services for Optus Enterprise and Business clients, including security architecture, engineering, monitoring, risk management, and compliance activities. The role requires strong expertise across multiple security domains, client engagement, and modern security technologies, including AI and machine learning, while working closely with stakeholders to design, implement, and continuously improve security solutions and controls

Your day to day will consist of

  • Lead day-to-day security operations, engineering, monitoring, and administration across enterprise security platforms and tools.

  • Evaluate, implement, and optimise emerging security technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities, to enhance detection, response, and compliance outcomes.

  • Maintain and improve security controls, vulnerability management, threat detection, policy compliance, and client security reporting.

  • Conduct security risk and threat assessments, develop security standards and procedures, and drive remediation activities with stakeholders.

  • Lead end-to-end incident response, including investigation, containment, recovery, post-incident reviews, and continuous improvement of response playbooks.

  • Coordinate security activities across clients and delivery teams, manage compliance obligations (ISO 27001, ISO 20000, SOC 2), and provide threat intelligence advisories.

What makes you perfect for the role

  • Strong hands-on experience with enterprise security technologies including SIEM, IDS/IPS, Endpoint Protection, Vulnerability Management, and IAM platforms.

  • Proven expertise in security incident response, covering the full lifecycle from detection and triage through to recovery and post-incident reviews.

  • Experience developing security processes, procedures, incident response playbooks, escalation pathways, and operational documentation.

  • Knowledge of AI/ML-driven security capabilities, automation, and analytics to enhance threat detection, investigation, and reporting outcomes.

  • Demonstrated ability to support project delivery, client engagements, audits, risk assessments, and security solution evaluations.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to perform effectively in fast-paced environments.

  • 3-5+ years of security operations experience, preferably supported by scripting skills (Python/PowerShell), security certifications (CISSP, CISM, CRISC), and familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2, and regulatory frameworks.

What's in it for you?

You’ll take ownership of comprehensive testing activities, from test case creation and execution through defect management and validation.
The role combines functional, integration, and regression testing with close collaboration across engineering and business teams.
You’ll help translate functional and technical requirements into effective testing strategies and actionable quality standards.
The position also offers the opportunity to improve testing processes and identify areas where automation can increase efficiency and coverage.
You’ll work independently while contributing to multiple Scrum teams and supporting complex technology initiatives.
This is a strong fit for a detail-oriented QA professional who enjoys solving problems and continuously improving software quality.

Accountabilities:

  • Perform integration, regression, and functional testing to ensure applications meet business, technical, and system requirements.
  • Create, review, maintain, and execute comprehensive test cases for new and modified systems.
  • Analyze functional and technical requirements and translate them into effective testing scenarios and quality criteria.
  • Identify, document, track, and manage defects through resolution while ensuring appropriate validation and follow-up.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders and Scrum teams within Agile delivery environments.
  • Support multiple teams and complex assignments while maintaining consistent quality and testing standards.
  • Apply established software engineering disciplines, change-control standards, and testing procedures throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Participate in peer code reviews and contribute to maintaining engineering and quality standards.
  • Provide insights and recommendations to improve testing processes, coverage, efficiency, and overall product quality.
  • Identify opportunities for test automation and contribute to approaches that support Test Driven Development where appropriate.
  • Work independently while adapting to evolving technologies, methodologies, and testing approaches.
  • Use analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate issues, reconcile results, and identify root causes.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of experience working in Scrum and Agile environments.
    • Extensive experience across the full software testing lifecycle, including test case development, test execution, defect management, and validation.
    • Strong experience performing functional, integration, and regression testing.
    • Advanced analytical, quantitative, deductive reasoning, reconciliation, and problem-solving capabilities.
    • Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to accuracy and quality.
    • Experience with Automated Change Management and established change-control processes.
    • Strong proficiency with word-processing, spreadsheet, and presentation software.
    • Ability to understand and analyze functional and technical requirements and convert them into comprehensive testing scenarios.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Scrum and cross-functional teams.
    • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and take ownership of complex testing assignments.
    • Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and testing methodologies.

title: FFSP Deployed Resiliency Counselor (DRC)
description:
The Fleet and Family Support Center (FFSC) San Diego is looking for the best, brightest and most adventurous clinical counselors to join our team as Deployed Resiliency Counselors (DRC). The DRC will serve as a credentialed clinical counselor aboard a Nuclear Powered Aircraft Carrier (CVN) or Large Deck Amphibious Assault Ship/ Landing Helicopter Assault Ship (LHD/LHA). The DRC is assigned to a ship and provides support services to deployed forces both in port or at sea.

The primary purpose of the Deployed Resiliency Counselor (DRC) is to provide professional short-term, solution-focused individual and group counseling for commonly occurring life situations and education on resiliency/wellness topics in a shipboard environment, throughout a ship's lifecycle (pier-side, shipyard maintenance, "workups" and deployments). The applicant will also serve as a liaison to the homeport Sexual Assault Response Coordinator (SARC), providing immediate sexual assault response and coordination to allegations of sexual assault. The success of this position is based on the incumbent's ability to successfully embed within the command and operate within a shipboard environment. The DRC actively engages crew members in various resiliency programs in order to ensure highest level of crew readiness for complex missions at sea. The DRC serves as a liaison to the homeport Family Advocacy Program (FAP) and provides safety assessment, safety planning, triage, and treatment for allegations of alleged child or domestic abuse. The DRC assesses and triages clients presenting with a risk of harm to self or others, with appropriate referral to the nearest behavioral health provider. Cases may involve multiple difficult and complex family problems including dual diagnoses, violence and impulsivity, suicidal and homicidal ideations and/or attempts, and a variety of other mental health problems. The DRC provides Sailor Assistance and Intercept for Life (SAIL) case management including assessment, safety planning, and care coordination for active-duty personnel with suicide related behavior. The DRC participates in Command Resiliency Team (CRT) initiatives, aiding and providing insight into active-duty wellness programs. Lastly, Performs other duties as assigned.

title: QA Engineer (SDET) - Risk Decision Workflow (m/f/d)
description:
We are looking for a

QA Engineer (m/f/d)

to join our team at our location in Berlin to build the next generation fintech

Riverty’s customers depend on accurate, consistent credit and payment risk decisions. In Risk Decision Workflows, quality is not a late-stage check: it is built into APIs, decision workflows, mocks, pipelines, and test evidence in Jira/Xray.

We are looking for someone who combines a tester’s judgment with an engineer’s delivery habits: you write tests, you make services testable, and you keep CI honest.

What will be your challenge:

As a QA Engineer, you will develop software for testing — automated tests, shared libraries, mocks, and pipeline stages — and you will keep the Risk platform’s quality visible to the team and the product owner. Day to day you will:

  • Plan and own test automation for existing and upcoming Risk work: unit tests, in-process functional/API tests, workflow/E2E coverage, and performance tests.
  • Design and implement tests for complex REST APIs and for Zoral Decision Engine (ZDE) workflows (authorization, creditworthiness, address/bank validation, and related Master decisions).
  • Keep services testable with developers: `WebApplicationFactory`, Testcontainers, PostgreSQL, WireMock, Docker Compose, and seeded test data.
  • Integrate and maintain automated tests in Azure Pipelines, including shared test templates, coverage, ReportPortal, Allure, and nightly Postman runs.
  • Own Xray/Jira traceability: review generated and handwritten cases, implement them in code, and keep reporting mapped to tickets and test plans.
  • Use and improve the team’s AI-assisted QA workflow. You remain the reviewer; the agent is not a replacement for judgment.
  • Maintain test architecture and team conventions so new tests stay consistent across repos.
  • Work with mock/stub data providers used by functional and performance testing.
  • Brainstorm upcoming work with the team, keep quality in the design conversation, and mentor others on testing approaches and tooling.
  • Give the product owner a clear view of current quality status and the test plan for upcoming work.

You will be using technologies:

  • Languages: C# / .NET, JavaScript / TypeScript, SQL
  • API & workflow testing: NUnit, xUnit, Postman / Postman CLI, HTTP clients, Gherkin/Xray
  • BDD / shared test libraries: Reqnroll, Testing Commons, AI agents
  • Test infrastructure: Docker, Docker Compose, Testcontainers, WireMock, PostgreSQL, mock external providers
  • CI/CD & Azure: Azure DevOps Pipelines, Azure (Key Vault, storage, ACR), Git, Terraform
  • Reporting & test management: Xray, ReportPortal, Jira, Confluence
  • Performance k6 and/or JMeter
  • Nice to have: Cypress, Kafka consumer testing

What will help you to succeed in the role:

  • 5+ years as SDET / QA Engineer / Quality Engineer, with automated tests in production CI
  • Solid knowledge of testing types and methods, and the judgment to choose unit vs integration vs functional vs E2E vs performance vs exploratory.
  • Strong experience testing complex APIs and integrations (auth, persistence, downstream HTTP, messaging). Comfort reading YAML/JSON configs and tracing behaviour across services.
  • Proven delivery of automated suites and, ideally, shared test libraries or pipeline templates - not only one-off scripts.
  • CI/CD, source control, and dependency management as a normal part of the job. Experience in a DevOps-style team.
  • BDD/Gherkin experience is useful (Xray/Reqnroll). It is not the only style we use; most new service tests are NUnit/xUnit. Comfort with mixed unit/integration/functional/E2E/performance tests across repos.
  • Curiosity about AI-assisted testing is a plus. Willingness to review, correct, and constrain generated tests is required.
  • As a person you are self-driven, proactive, and able to talk to both business and engineering stakeholders and fluent in English.

Being a Associate director in the Data Science team, you will play a critical role in developing the next generation of E-commerce measurement solutions we offer our clients, powered by statistical algorithms, ML and AI and leveraging large volumes of internal , client and third party data.

You’ll be actively participating with other team members in the overall Product creation process.   • Translate product requirements to actionable solutions or products
  • Ideate and develop solutions for the product innovation pipeline
  • Define the given business problem as a scientific research problem

  • Research solutions, set and execute experiments, prototype the solution and support Technology team on productionalizing them
  • Build statistical and analytical models (including ML/AI approaches) as prototypes and POCs to address specific client business needs

  • Read, write, comment, maintain, and share legible and quality computer code utilized in prototyping and suctioning.

description:
Senior Director Biostatistics Late Infectious Disease

Introduction to role:Are you ready to set the statistical direction for late-stage infectious disease programs and shape the evidence that delivers life-changing medicines to patients worldwide? In this high-impact leadership role, you will guide the design, analysis and interpretation of pivotal and life-cycle studies, transforming complex data into clear decisions that drive approvals, access and successful commercialization.

You will lead a team of leaders, align Biostatistics strategy with enterprise priorities, and partner closely with Clinical, Regulatory, Medical and Data functions to accelerate timelines without compromising scientific rigor. Can you influence global strategy while coaching the next generation of statistical leaders, all while ensuring uncompromising data integrity and regulatory excellence?

Accountabilities:- Biostatistics Strategy: Develop and implement the Biostatistics strategy for late-stage infectious disease, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and portfolio priorities.- Portfolio Leadership: Manage global Biostatistics processes and systems, coordinate interfaces with global organizations, and lead a team of leaders to deliver across the portfolio.- Clinical Development Influence: Offer insights and recommendations to the global clinical development strategy across therapeutic areas, optimizing statistical considerations from study design to decision-making.- Regulatory Submissions: Define and contribute statistical findings and clinical data summaries; author key elements of regulatory submission dossiers; represent Biostatistics in health authority interactions.- Talent Development: Lead, mentor and develop the Biostatistics team; oversee the performance of senior managers; identify development opportunities; plan for succession to ensure leadership continuity.- Quality, Efficiency and Innovation: Direct initiatives that enhance quality, improve data integrity, optimize cost-efficiency and reduce timelines; where applicable, lead methodological or process innovations that deliver measurable business value.- Governance and Compliance: Ensure regulatory compliance and inspection readiness; uphold global standards, procedures and robust statistical practices throughout the development lifecycle.

Essential Skills/Experience:Master's in Statistics or a related field; Recognized professional qualification; Expertise in biostatistics; Proven ability to lead functional and cross-functional teams; Demonstrated leadership in motivating and empowering teams; Comprehensive knowledge of drug development and commercialization processes; Capability to set and direct global priorities, resources, and projects; Experience managing teams in a global context; Strong conceptual and strategic thinking skills; Ability to strategically influence and tactfully persuade.

Desirable Skills/Experience:PhD in a scientific discipline; Recognized expert with a strong reputation in business and industry; Extensive knowledge of the latest technical and regulatory expectations; Operational expertise in risk management and contingency planning; Familiarity with the latest research and developments; Effective problem-solving and conflict resolution skills; Proven team-oriented approach; Comprehensive knowledge of AstraZeneca policies, procedures, and guidelines.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

The annual base pay (or hourly rate of compensation) for this position ranges from $221,036.00 - 331,554.00 USD Annual . Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Your work will be visible across the enterprise and externally, spanning multiple therapy areas and connecting directly to patient impact. You will collaborate in rooms where diverse perspectives spark new solutions, supported by leaders who encourage both ambition and kindness, and backed by significant investment in science and technology. Here, continuous learning is the norm, rigorous standards guide our decisions, and your statistical expertise drives pivotal moments—from trial design to regulatory approval—that change the trajectory of disease for patients worldwide.

Step forward today to lead the statistical vision for late-stage infectious disease and create evidence that makes a measurable difference for patients and science!

title: Finance Business Partner
description:
• Partner with senior operational and executive leaders to influence commercial and financial decision-making across Network Aviation
  • Play a key role in finance transformation, continuous improvement, and business performance initiatives
  • Join a growing finance team where you'll help build capability and contribute to the future direction of the function

At Network Aviation, we're incredibly proud of our West Australian heritage. We play an important role in connecting communities and industries, operating over 300 weekly flights to destinations throughout WA and beyond. These flights include Fly-in, Fly-out (FIFO) services for the resources industry, corporate charter, routine or emergency freight, as well as regular airline services on behalf of Qantas.

As a Finance Business Partner, you will work closely with the Finance Business Partner Lead and senior stakeholders across the business to provide financial planning, analysis and strategic advice that supports operational and commercial decision-making. You will play a critical role in management reporting, financial control, budgeting and forecasting, while challenging and supporting the business to achieve its performance objectives.

This is an opportunity for a commercially minded finance professional who enjoys building relationships, influencing outcomes, and driving continuous improvement in a dynamic operational environment.

You will:

  • Partner with senior operational, commercial and executive stakeholders
  • Lead budgeting, forecasting, management reporting and financial performance analysis activities
  • Provide insight and recommendations to support strategic decision-making
  • Analyse business performance and identify opportunities to improve outcomes
  • Support investment decisions, business cases and project reviews
  • Drive finance transformation and process improvement initiatives
  • Strengthen reporting, governance and financial control processes
  • Lead and influence key stakeholders across the business to achieve financial and operational objectives
  • Support compliance, risk management and audit activities
  • Coach, mentor and help build capability across the wider finance team

To be considered, you’ll have:

  • Tertiary qualifications in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or a related discipline
  • CA or CPA qualification (or equivalent)
  • Significant experience in business partnering, management accounting or commercial finance roles
  • Strong budgeting, forecasting, reporting and financial analysis capability
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate financial information into commercial insights
  • Experience working within complex operational or asset-intensive environments
  • Strong communication, relationship-building and stakeholder management skills
  • A continuous improvement mindset with experience driving process or systems enhancements
  • Demonstrated leadership capability through mentoring, coaching or leading projects and initiatives
  • Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at the Qantas Group. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.

You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.

The Qantas Group is an equal opportunity employer, so by coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Azure Data Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Azure Data Engineer based in Sweden.

This role offers the opportunity to strengthen cybersecurity operations by engineering reliable, scalable security data pipelines across cloud and on-premises environments.
You will work with high volumes of security telemetry and help ensure critical data is available for threat detection, incident response, compliance, and cyber risk visibility.
The position combines hands-on data engineering with cybersecurity, cloud technologies, automation, and data quality management.
You’ll collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, governance, and vendor teams to onboard and optimize diverse data sources.
The role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys troubleshooting complex ingestion challenges and improving system reliability and efficiency.
You’ll operate in a highly regulated financial services environment where data integrity, security, and operational excellence are essential.
This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on the organization’s ability to detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable security data ingestion pipelines for SIEM and cloud data platforms, including Azure Data Explorer and Log Analytics.
  • Parse, normalize, transform, enrich, and validate structured and unstructured security telemetry using regex, JSON parsing, schema mapping, and other data-processing techniques.
  • Partner with application owners, infrastructure and cloud teams, vendors, security stakeholders, and other internal groups to onboard new log sources and validate end-to-end data flows.
  • Ensure the integrity, completeness, timeliness, and quality of security telemetry used for monitoring, detection, incident response, reporting, and risk management.
  • Align security data with established schemas, naming conventions, governance standards, and organizational requirements to support downstream analytics and automation.
  • Troubleshoot ingestion, parsing, transformation, schema, and data-quality issues across diverse platforms and environments.
  • Maintain clear documentation covering log onboarding procedures, source requirements, data mappings, pipeline configurations, and operational support processes.
  • Collaborate with detection engineering and security operations teams to ensure telemetry supports investigation, threat detection, response, and cyber risk use cases.
  • Conduct telemetry gap analyses, identify missing or incomplete data sources, and recommend priorities for improving security coverage.
  • Support logging practices that meet regulatory, audit, compliance, retention, and data-integrity requirements.
  • Improve ingestion frameworks, automation, and onboarding processes to increase scalability, repeatability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Support infrastructure-as-code, scripting, and automation initiatives that streamline deployment and ongoing pipeline maintenance.
  • Monitor pipeline performance and work with stakeholders to optimize ingestion reliability, throughput, and operational costs.
  • Stay current with emerging cybersecurity telemetry formats, logging standards, data engineering practices, and cloud security data-platform capabilities.

    • Requirements:

    • 3+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, data engineering, log management, security operations, or a related technology discipline.
    • Hands-on experience onboarding, managing, and validating log sources within SIEM, cloud data platforms, or security analytics environments.
    • Strong understanding of data parsing, normalization, transformation, and validation, including experience with regex, JSON, XML, CSV, and both structured and unstructured data.
    • Familiarity with security telemetry from network, endpoint, identity, application, cloud, and infrastructure environments.
    • Experience working with cloud platforms and associated logging, monitoring, and analytics services, particularly within the Azure ecosystem.
    • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to diagnose pipeline, ingestion, schema, and data-quality problems.
    • Understanding of compliance and regulatory requirements related to logging, retention, auditability, and data integrity.
    • Experience with scripting or automation technologies such as Python, PowerShell, or similar tools is preferred.
    • Familiarity with query languages used to validate, investigate, and analyze ingested security data.
    • Ability to coordinate complex onboarding initiatives across internal teams, vendors, and multiple stakeholders.
    • Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance operational support, project delivery, and continuous improvement.
    • Exceptional attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership for data quality and technical outcomes.
    • Broader cybersecurity experience in areas such as threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, or cloud security is an advantage.
    • Strong communication, collaboration, judgment, and accountability, with the ability to work effectively within global teams.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote work opportunity from anywhere.
      • Opportunity to work on cybersecurity data engineering within a highly regulated financial services environment.
      • Exposure to large-scale security telemetry, SIEM platforms, Azure data services, cloud environments, and security operations.
      • Hands-on opportunities to develop scalable pipelines, automation, infrastructure-as-code, and data-quality solutions.
      • Cross-functional collaboration with cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, application, governance, and vendor teams.
      • Opportunity to contribute directly to threat detection, incident response, compliance, and cyber risk visibility.
      • Professional growth through exposure to evolving cloud security, telemetry, and data engineering technologies.
      • A collaborative global working environment with opportunities to solve complex technical challenges.

title: Nuclear Medicine Technologist
description:
This position is located in the Imaging Service, Charlie Norwood VAMC, Augusta GA- downtown location. The Nuclear Medicine Technologist (NMT) has the overall responsibility for the coordination and performance of Nuclear Medicine examinations including Nuclear Cardiology, General Nuclear Medicine, PET/CT and Hot Lab duties. He/she works closely with other staff to provide a wide range of specialized nuclear medicine procedures.

Duties include but not limited to: Prepare, assay, and administer radiopharmaceutical doses by injection, inhalation or ingestion as prescribed. Be proficient in introducing intravenous catheters in patients for administration of radiopharmaceuticals and/or medications. Be knowledgeable regarding possible side effects of radiopharmaceuticals and other medications, such as Lasix and Captopril, to be administered. Take immediate action to remedy any noted effects. Obtain pertinent clinical data from the patient, electronic chart, requisition, and interviewing the patient and /or the family. Move wheelchair and litter patients safely using ergonomic methods of patient transfer. Operate nuclear medicine equipment such as gamma cameras, PET/CT, well counters, GM survey meters, thyroid uptake system, and dose calibrators for various patient procedures. Understand and be able to perform exposure rate calculations. Perform a full range of nuclear medicine diagnostic imaging, non-imaging, in-vitro and therapeutic procedures, including highly specialized computer assisted studies such as gated, tomographic, quantitative procedures, SPECT/CT and PET/CT. Keep up to date with new imaging agents, procedures and methods. Write imaging protocols for use in department. Analyze procedure images for quality. Obtain additional images when necessary. Correctly administer radioactive pharmaceuticals to patients. Utilizes necessary quality management methods of patient identification such as using two unique identifiers and active rather than passive identification. Participate in research projects involving Nuclear Medicine studies, products, equipment, and/or radiopharmaceuticals. Schedule patient procedures, taking into consideration camera availability, scan length, patient condition, the need for multiple nuclear medicine studies, other clinic appointments of the patient, contraindications for the test and urgency of the request. Inform patient of all pertinent preparations for his he/her scan, i.e. NPO, follow certain diet, bowel prep, etc. Performs CT studies in accordance to set protocols with optimization to reduce radiation dose under the supervision of a Radiologist if ARR T( CT) certified. Performs 12 lead EKG on patient, monitor vital signs including heart rate, blood pressure, obtain pertinent patient history. Provide IV supplies and charts for physician. Prepare studies for nuclear medicine physician's interpretation by insuring completeness of all forms involved in the procedure. Record appropriate data and related information on the proper patient worksheet and images. Other duties as assigned. As a Tech Project Lead, you will manage and coordinate store‑related tech rollout projects by leading planning, resources, cross‑functional collaboration, vendors and risk management. You will ensure smooth implementation, strong delivery and seamless transition to operations in line with global standards. You will be responsible for the Sales Market, consisting of the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Romania and Hungary.

You will:

  • Plan, coordinate and manage end‑to‑end store‑related tech rollouts across the Sales Market.
  • Support Tech functions responsible for execution by providing structured project management.
  • Secure effective resource allocation and alignment throughout the full project lifecycle.
  • Lead cross‑functional project teams, collaborating with Expansion, Retail Operations, Sales and Tech.
  • Manage external vendors during retail tech implementation and rollout.
  • Identify and manage risks, blockers and dependencies, securing smooth delivery.
  • Track outcomes, gather learnings and drive continuous improvement across rollout processes.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH​

As a Tech Project Lead, you will collaborate closely with Expansion, Retail Operations, Sales, Tech teams and external vendors. You will work under the Sales Market Tech Manager while partnering across functions to secure high‑quality retail tech delivery.

WHO YOU ARE​

We are looking for people with …

  • A degree in Business, IT, Engineering or a related field.
  • ~3+ years of experience in project management, ideally in retail or tech environments.
  • Proven track record of leading cross‑functional IT implementation projects.
  • Experience working in agile environments and collaborating with product teams.
  • Strong problem‑solving abilities and confidence navigating complexity and ambiguity.
  • Proficiency with project management tools and Microsoft Office.
  • Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

And people who are…

  • Strong communicators with the ability to build trust, manage stakeholders at different levels and maintain alignment across multiple functions.
  • Skilled at translating technical information into clear, simple business understanding.
  • Structured, clear and confident when guiding teams through complex deliveries.
  • Proactive and solution‑oriented, acting early when risks or blockers appear.
  • Curious, flexible and energized by working in fast‑moving retail‑tech environments.

WHO WE ARE​

H&M group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

More specifically, we offer:

  • 25% staff discount for you and one family member across all H&M Group brands – in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET).
  • Working mode: 4 days from office / 1 day flexible.
  • Meal Allowance – Receive a meal allowance of 90 Kč for each working day, included in your salary.
  • H&M HIP incentive program.
  • Relaxing Days - 2 additional days off in your first year and 4 days annually after your first year with us.
  • Referral bonus for recommending externally hired colleagues.
  • Co-financed access to either a Multisport Card.
  • Occasional coupons and bonuses throughout the year.
  • Extra Annual Leave - 1 additional vacation day after 6 months of employment.
  • Additional day off (jubilee).
  • Educational Learning Studio platform, including LinkedIn Learning.
  • Structured year-round development process with goal setting, performance evaluation, and achievement review.
  • Career opportunities, with 70% of our recruitment processes filled through internal promotions.

JOIN US​

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

This is a full-time role based on a local contract in Prague, Czech Republic. The Tech Project Lead reports to the Tech Manager.

If you feel that this is an opportunity that will drive you, please apply with your CV in English no later than 6th Sept 2026. Due to data privacy policies, we only accept applications via our career page.

Take the next step in your career with us. The journey starts here.
